system.description:
You conjure your lightning release chakra creating a lightning release construct lance, staff or polearm of your description that as an action can make a Lightning Strike Attack, bonus action to perform a Lightning Supercharge, or as a Reaction to taking damage perform a Lightning Guard. For the duration of this jutsu you do not need to spend chakra to maintain concentration on this jutsu.

Lightning Strike Attack. Make a melee ninjutsu attack against a creature up to 10 feet away dealing 4d10 lightning damage on a hit.

Lightning Supercharge. As a bonus action charge the Lance with more chakra. The next Lightning Strike Attack you make Pierces 6 DR.

Lightning Guard. As a reaction to taking damage, you spin your weapon attempting to guard some of the force of the strike, gaining 6 DR vs incoming damage, except wind, until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage this jutsu deals by 1d10 and the DR gained by +2S.
